packageRules.description: Roundcube publishes no plain version tags: every release is tagged per image flavour (`1.7.3-apache-nonroot`, `1.7.3-fpm`, ...), and semver reads the flavour as a pre-release, so `roundcube_version` has never seen an update. Extracting the version out of the flavour that this role actually deploys makes those releases visible again.
